messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=v2.14.0 image=web:sha=ff12a9 -> canary prod-us-west1. healthcheck: 502 on /api/health. link: https://deploy/release/1775012345
Priya: saw the 502s on canary alert, digging in. staging canary was fine earlier today. :thinking_face:
Josh: quick check: staging and prod configs differ for KMS alias. staging uses alias/redwood-staging-kms, prod uses alias/redwood-kms. Could this be key access?
Alex: did the rollout use the new envtemplater job? I remember a change to helm values templating yesterday.
Rachel: running `kubectl get cm api-config -n prod -o yaml` shows FEATURE_FLAGS: "FEATURE_X: false". In staging the same key is "FEATURE_X: true".
Priya: that's bad. FEATURE_X toggles new auth path that expects signed tokens via KMS. If prod has it off, route might try fallback and trigger 502.
Josh: also noticed secret name mismatch: in staging we mount secret redwood-db-secret, in prod the deployment references REDWOOD_DB_PASSWORD from secret redwood-db-pw (different name). That's probably from last week's config rename not propagated to prod values.
Alex: ugh. So two parity issues: feature flag default + secret naming. Both could cause runtime failures.
oncall-ops: Can we roll back the canary image while we reconcile configs? Current canary is 10% traffic.
Priya: yes recommend rollback. I'll pin canary to previous image web:sha=e3b0c4 now.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: target image web:sha=e3b0c4 -> canary prod-us-west1. Status: in progress.
Rachel: I'm opening a quick PR to sync prod values with staging: prod/values.yaml update to use redwood-db-secret and set FEATURE_X: true. Will include KMS alias check.
Josh: double-check KMS key policy too. Staging's service account had kms.decrypt on alias/redwood-staging-kms; prod SA didn't have alias/redwood-kms permission in the change.
Alex: create an ENG ticket for the root cause and actions: - reconcile values across envs - add a helm test to validate secret names - add a pre-deploy parity check for FEATURE_FLAGS and key policies.
Priya: filing ENG-2345 now with links to diffs and the rollback action.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete: canary now web:sha=e3b0c4. Traffic redistributed back. :white_check_mark:
oncall-ops: monitoring — initial 5m post-rollback looks stable, no 502 spikes.
Rachel: will schedule the config sync and KMS policy fix during next change window (tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC) unless anyone objects.
Alex: fine by me. Also add a preflight script on CI that compares configmap keys across envs and fails if mismatched.
Josh: I'll own the KMS policy change with Priya.
Priya: ping me when PR is ready. Thanks everyone for the quick response. :heart:
deploy-bot: Note: linked incident ENG-2345 created. Tags: env-parity, rollback, hotfix, release."
